description: Quote swapping AETH for OSMO in the AETH/OSMO pool on Osmosis testnet: the OSMO the swap would return after Osmosis's taker fee and the pool's fee, the price before the swap and the price it gets, what fees and price impact cost together, and a minOutput for a slippage you choose. Read-only: it reads Osmosis's own estimate and moves nothing. The pool is small and moves with every trade, so quote just before you swap.

amount.description: the AETH to swap, with its unit: "1 AETH" or "1000000uaeth"

slippagePercent.description: how far below this quote a swap may fill, for minOutput (default 1, at most 50)

name: quote_swap

chain.description: where the pool is: Osmosis testnet

costPercent.description: how far price is below spotPrice: fees and price impact together

aeth.description: AETH amounts only: the amount in AETH

amount.description: the amount in the asset's own unit, e.g. 1.5

asset.description: AETH, or USDC (the one its owner configured: issuer and route are in origin)

base.description: the same amount in the asset's smallest unit (uaeth or uusdc; 1 = 1,000,000 of them)

denom.description: the chain's name for the asset: uaeth, or ibc/... for USDC

uaeth.description: AETH amounts only: the amount in uaeth

minOutput.description: the least to accept: the estimate less slippagePercent. A swap set to this fails (and refunds) rather than fill below it

denomOnAether.description: the denom it arrives as on Aether

out.description: Osmosis's estimate of what the swap returns, after its taker fee and the pool's swap fee

denomOnAether.description: the denom it arrives as on Aether

price.description: OSMO per AETH this swap gets

spotPrice.description: OSMO per AETH before this swap, from the reserves

swapFeePercent.description: the pool's own fee; Osmosis's taker fee comes on top

title: Quote AETH to OSMO swap
